replies.text: We got your message. We will reply on the next working day.

I can tell you the session fee, when we are open, and what we treat. I can also tell you which documents a tax return needs. To book, say which day and what time suits you. Ask in your own words. A person replies to anything else.

A standard one-on-one physiotherapy session is R650. An initial assessment is also R650 for a 45-minute appointment. Payment is due at the end of each visit. We accept card and EFT. We do not publish medical-aid tariff codes. Phone reception for medical-aid queries. To book, tell me the day and the time, for example Tuesday at 10.

We are open Monday to Friday and close at 5:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Public holidays are closed. There is no list of open appointment times. To book, tell me the day and the time, for example Tuesday at 10.

We treat adults for sports injury assessment and rehabilitation, post-operative physiotherapy, neck, back, and shoulder pain, dry needling, manual therapy, and home exercise programmes. We do not run a paediatric ward or an emergency service. This is what we offer, not a list of open times. To book, tell me the day and the time, for example Tuesday at 10.

When we prepare your personal tax return, please provide your IRP5 or IT3(a) from each employer for the tax year, bank statements for interest earned, a medical aid tax certificate if you have one, retirement annuity contribution certificates, proof of donations to registered public benefit organisations, a rental income schedule if you let property, and a travel logbook if you claim a travel allowance. We do not start work until we have these items or a written list of what is still outstanding.
